text: {"lessons":["Recent price moves did not reliably predict what came next, so I should not chase a falling stock or buy simply because it has dipped.","Selling Stock D after a large gain felt satisfying, but a gain relative to my average cost is not by itself a reason to sell; I should consider the position's role and my plan.","My account continued to lose value while I mostly held positions, so I should reassess concentration, cash, and risk deliberately rather than treating inaction as automatically prudent."]}
